name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A free tool that makes an AI assistant draw clean, magazine-quality diagrams (flowcharts, org charts, timelines) instead of the generic, ugly boxes most AI tools produce.
buyer: A content marketer or startup founder writing blog posts, pitch decks, or docs who needs professional-looking diagrams fast but can't afford a designer or 30 minutes fighting with Figma.
business_use_cases: A startup founder uses it to generate an architecture diagram and funnel chart for an investor pitch deck in minutes instead of hiring a designer.
A content agency bakes it into their blog-writing workflow so every explainer post ships with a matching branded diagram.
A technical writer at a SaaS company uses it to keep documentation diagrams visually consistent across dozens of pages.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'brand kit' service: match the diagram styles to a client's exact brand colors/fonts and deliver a ready-to-use skill config.
Run a diagram-generation service for content agencies who want polished visuals without learning the tool themselves.

steal_this: Offer a $9 'brand your diagrams' Fiverr gig: take a client's website, read their brand colors, and hand back a pre-configured version of this skill so their diagrams always match their site.
